title: fetch_question result
description: One shape for every outcome. An empty bank is exhausted:true with null question fields, not an error and not a throw. referenceAnswer is deliberately absent: a model holding the model answer paraphrases it into its follow-ups, which destroys the question.

question.description: The question text to put to the candidate. Null when exhausted.

aiSrc.description: Avatar video URL for this question, or null when the question has no clip.

exhausted.description: True when the bank has no question left that satisfies the request.

remaining.description: Unserved questions left in the bank after this call.
